title: Early Access Terraform resources: extranet, data center exclusions, subclouds

prose.text: Several newer ZIA resources are labelled Early Access in the provider documentation. They cover extranet configuration and the exclusion of data centers or subclouds from serving traffic.

prose.label: Which are Early Access.
prose.text: {{early-access-resources}} Who can use them is open {{gap:early-access-eligibility}}.

prose.label: Data center exclusions.
prose.text: {{dc-id-from-datacenters}} {{utc-overrides-unix}} The data source's behavior with an invalid ID is in [[zia.terraform.data-source-fidelity]].

checks.do: Whether the resource is one of the Early Access ones before blaming a failure on provider behavior; eligibility is not documented.
Whether `datacenter_id` and `cloud_id` came from the right data source, since they identify different entities.
Whether an exclusion window was set through the UTC string, which overrides the Unix timestamp.

early-access-resources.statement: The provider documentation marks `zia_url_categories_predefined`, `zia_sandbox_behavioral_analysis_v2`, `zia_extranet`, `zia_dc_exclusions` and `zia_sub_cloud` as Early Access features.

dc-id-from-datacenters.statement: `zia_dc_exclusions` takes `datacenter_id` from the `zia_datacenters` data source (the documentation prefers `data.zia_datacenters.this.datacenter_id` when filtering by name returns one result); the argument is required on create, can be omitted when importing by numeric ID, and forces a new resource if changed.

quotes: Prefer `data.zia_datacenters.this.datacenter_id` when filtering by name with a single result. Force new if changed.
Required when creating; can be omitted when importing by numeric ID.

sub-cloud-id-from-own-data-source.statement: `zia_sub_cloud` takes `cloud_id` from the `zia_sub_cloud` data source read by name (the example passes `data.zia_sub_cloud.lookup.id`), while the excluded data center is `exclusions.datacenter.id`, a data center ID chosen with the `zia_datacenters` data source, not the subcloud `cloud_id`.

quotes: cloud_id = data.zia_sub_cloud.lookup.id
exclusions { datacenter { id = data.zia_datacenters.this.datacenters[0].id
data "zia_sub_cloud" "lookup" { name = "BIZDevZSThree01" }
* `exclusions` - (List) List of data centers excluded from the subcloud.
* `datacenter` - (List, Required, MaxItems: 1) The excluded datacenter reference.
* `id` - (Integer, Required) Unique identifier for the datacenter.
Use the datasource `zia_datacenters` to retrieve the list of available datacenter IDs

sub-cloud-name-read-only.statement: The subcloud `name` is read-only: if it is provided the provider ignores it and uses the name from the API response.

quotes: If provided, it will be ignored and the name from the API response will be used instead.

utc-overrides-unix.statement: For `zia_dc_exclusions`, `start_time_utc` and `end_time_utc` (format `MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM am/pm`) override the Unix-timestamp `start_time` and `end_time` when set, and one form of each of start and end must be given.

quotes: * `start_time` - (Integer, Optional/Computed) Unix timestamp when the exclusion window starts.
* `end_time` - (Integer, Optional/Computed) Unix timestamp when the exclusion window ends.
Exclusion window start (UTC). Format: `MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM am/pm`. If set, overrides `start_time`.
Either `start_time` or `start_time_utc` must be set.
Either `end_time` or `end_time_utc` must be set.
Exclusion window end (UTC). Format: `MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM am/pm`. If set, overrides `end_time`.

early-access-eligibility.title: Which tenants can use the Early Access Terraform resources
early-access-eligibility.detail: Unverified legacy statement: Early Access status and tenant eligibility criteria for `zia_url_categories_predefined` are not documented in the provider source, and availability may vary by ZIA edition and cloud environment. The provider documentation marks the resource Early Access but does not say how a tenant becomes eligible, and the same applies to the other Early Access resources.
early-access-eligibility.blocks: saying whether an Early Access resource will work on a given tenant or cloud
